newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenyin & Wanguo recommends China Int'l Travel.
newsitem.headline: Shenyin & Wanguo recommends China Int'l Travel.

text.p: Shenyin & Wanguo, China's top brokerage, has recommended Shanghai China International Travel Service Co Ltd B shares as a buy due to the company's good prospects in the next few years.

A research paper provided to Reuters on Monday said the travel agency, occupying more than 30 percent market share in Shanghai, was expected to have a rise of 10 percent per year in its net profit over the next three years.
"The company is expected to fulfil its 1996 turnover and net profit target," the research paper.
The company has said its turnover target for 1996 was 500 million yuan ($60 million) with net profit to reach 42 million yuan.
The paper said group overseas travellers are still their main source for profit, accounting for 70 percent of the total turnover.

"At the same time, more and more Chinese people travel (independently) abroad, with the number increasing 328 percent to 3,000 in 1996 from 1995's 700," the research paper said. "This will become the company's new source of profit."
"Meanwhile, people taking part in domestic travel also increased sharply, with the number up 150 percent to 20,000 in 1996 against 8,000 in 1995," the report said.
It said about 1.26 million people would come to China for a 1997 travel festival, which will bring good business opportunities for the company.
